# Nutrition Geeks

> Science-based nutrition and fitness strategies for athletes, with marathon-proven guidance on supplements, weight management, and performance optimization.

Founded by Nathan, a marathon runner and nutrition coach, Nutrition Geeks provides comprehensive resources on dietary supplements, sports nutrition, health optimization, and healthy recipes. The site combines athletic training expertise with evidence-based nutritional science.
